title.zh: 将卡加延省拉洛市镇圣安东尼奥描笼涯拉富小学的名称变更为圣安东尼奥小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Lafu Elementary School in Barangay San Antonio, Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, to San Antonio Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Lafu Elementary School in Barangay San Antonio, Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, to San Antonio Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Lafu tại Barangay San Antonio, Thị trấn Lallo, Tỉnh Cagayan thành Trường tiểu học San Antonio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Lafu ในบารังไกย์ San Antonio, เทศบาล Lallo, จังหวัด Cagayan เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Antonio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Lafu di Barangay San Antonio, Kotamadya Lallo, Provinsi Cagayan menjadi Sekolah Dasar San Antonio
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Lafu di Barangay San Antonio, Perbandaran Lallo, Wilayah Cagayan menjadi Sekolah Rendah San Antonio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6815_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Lafu Elementary School in Barangay San Antonio, Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, is hereby changed to San Antonio Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
